issue_context.title: Deprecate NodeLabel, ServiceAffinityand NodePreferAvoidPods from scheduler's CC api
issue_context.body:
NodeLabel and ServiceAffinity are what used to be called customer predicates and priorities. Since we have GA alternatives to those (NodeAffintiy and inter-pod affinity), I believe we should deprecate them from the plugin's API in CC before it gets to GA.

This is important because if CC makes it to GA, we can deprecate those plugins only by going to v2. 

Basically we should:
1) Deprecate their args from CC (requires going to v1Beta2)
2) Keep the logic, and allow configuring them only through the policy api
3) Remove the logic once the policy api is deprecated

/sig scheduling
/cc @mikedanese @Huang-Wei @alculquicondor
comments: @ahg-g Can work on this. Let me know if we have finalized an approach around this.

@hprateek43 are you still interested in doing this one? for this release we need to 

- PR1: introduce v1beta2 
  - copy `https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/tree/master/staging/src/k8s.io/kube-scheduler/config/v1beta1` to `https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/tree/master/staging/src/k8s.io/kube-scheduler/config/v1beta2` and modify the package name to v1beta2 and update the [SchemeGroupVersion](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/staging/src/k8s.io/kube-scheduler/config/v1beta1/register.go#L28)
  - similarly copy `https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/tree/master/pkg/scheduler/apis/config/v1beta1` to `https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/tree/master/pkg/scheduler/apis/config/v1beta2` and make the necessary adjustments.
  - update [getPluginArgsOrDefault](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/c87dd9c5121edc26f654f569002d69daee1e1fc4/pkg/scheduler/framework/runtime/framework.go#L330) to use v1beta2
- PR2: remove `NodeLabelArgs` and `ServiceAffinityArgs` arguments from the new v1beta2 api

@alculquicondor I am assuming the above is good enough to block using those plugins in v1beta2 because conversion will fail if someone tries to use those plugins because the arg types don't exist and [defaulting](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/c87dd9c5121edc26f654f569002d69daee1e1fc4/pkg/scheduler/framework/runtime/framework.go#L331) will return an error. Not the best experience may be, so let me know if there is a more explicit way.
actually you can do the two steps above in one PR.
I can pick this up
Sg, let's do it in separate PRs so that the second one include the deprecation notice in the release notes.

This is what will happen if someone using v1beta2 tries to use one of the removed plugins, with the plan above.

1. During conversion, there are 2 possibilities:
  1. if there's a PluginConfig for it, it will be treated as out-of-tree and converted into runtime.Unknown.
  1. if there's no PluginConfig for it, `getPluginArgsOrDefault` returns nil.
1. The plugin instantiation would fail here: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/c87dd9c5121edc26f654f569002d69daee1e1fc4/pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/nodelabel/node_label.go#L59


I think we should put a `log.Warning` in the plugin instantiation, additionally to the plan above. If we want to be more extreme, we could produce an error here https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/c87dd9c5121edc26f654f569002d69daee1e1fc4/staging/src/k8s.io/kube-scheduler/config/v1beta1/types.go#L225, but I'm not sure if it's a good practice. I assume there wouldn't be out-of-tree plugins with the same name.

OTH, I wonder if this is the pattern of deprecation we want to go with all the time. Would it be possible to just fire a deprecation notice for a couple of versions and then remove it?
Should we take this opportunity to deprecate "NodePreferAvoidPods" as well? Taints should cover this too.
yeah, lets deprecate `NodePreferAvoidPods` as well
FYI @damemi, who asked about this in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/92507#discussion_r500607005
/retitle Deprecate NodeLabel, ServiceAffinityand NodePreferAvoidPods from scheduler's CC api
